title: Weakly Conditioned Diffusion Model Augmentation for Prostate Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34230v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning models for prostate MRI segmentation often struggle to generalize when trained on limited heterogeneous data, leading to boundary errors and over-segmentation. We present an augmentation framework using mask-conditioned synthetic and diverse T2-weighted MRI volumes to improve boundary precision and reduce over-segmentation. We employ a 2.5D weakly mask-conditioned denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) via channel concatenation. The diffusion model conditions on stacks of adjacent binary masks from training folds. The model generates T2 volumes consistent with the conditioning anatomy while diversifying tissue appearance. We evaluate the proposed approach on two cohorts of data: (i) the LUND probe cohort (n=432) for strategy selection and training nnU-Net from scratch with a 23% synthetic data mix, and (ii) the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) prostate cohort (n=32) evaluated with a 20% synthetic data mix. translated_title: 用于前列腺分割的弱条件扩散模型数据增强方法
translated_abstract: 基于深度学习的前列腺MRI分割模型在有限异构数据上训练时往往难以泛化，导致边界误差和过度分割问题。我们提出了一种数据增强框架，利用掩码条件合成的多样化T2加权MRI体积来提高边界精度并减少过度分割。我们通过通道拼接的方式采用2.5D弱掩码条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）。该扩散模型以训练折中相邻二值掩码的堆叠作为条件，生成与条件解剖结构一致的T2体积，同时使组织外观多样化。我们在两个数据队列上评估了所提出的方法：(i) LUND探针队列（n=432），用于策略选择并以23%合成数据混合比例从头训练nnU-Net；(ii) 医学分割十项全能挑战赛（MSD）前列腺队列（n=32），以20%合成数据混合比例进行评估。
tldr: 提出一种弱掩码条件扩散模型数据增强框架，通过生成解剖结构一致且组织外观多样的合成T2加权MRI体积，提升前列腺分割的边界精度并减少过度分割。
en_tdlr: A weakly mask-conditioned diffusion model augmentation framework generates diverse synthetic T2-weighted MRI volumes to improve boundary precision and reduce over-segmentation in prostate segmentation.
